parsed.explanation: State-tolerated targeting dominates: police specifically target trans women with arbitrary detention, forced examinations amounting to torture, and persistent impunity, with prosecutions under Article 120 documented through 2023. Extortion, coerced informing and arrest threats are described as routine, and official hostility is on record (SOGI omitted from the 2023 constitution; an unverified proposed speech ban). No anti-discrimination law, unregistered LGBTI organisations, and continuing societal harassment leave effectively no recourse for an outed visitor. Border, facility and document practices are undocumented, so no additional deduction or credit there. There is no documented execution or killing campaign, which keeps this above the 0.15 anchors, but the documented state-perpetrated custody torture and failed remedy place it firmly below the 0.25 tier.
